goal: A role entry like cli:cursor-agent:gpt-5.6-sol-high in a profile's roles: reaches ~/.agents/roles.yaml only when it can run; a malformed one fails agentfiles sync and plan with a clear error instead of reaching agents as a second_opinion.py exit 2 (ROADMAP R13).
changed: parse_roles checks every role value that starts with cli: (alone or in a list) as cli:<agent>:<model>, with the agent in CLI_AGENTS (claude, cursor-agent) and a non-empty model. This covers profiles, project .agentfiles.yaml and local.yaml roles.

CLI_AGENTS copies second_opinion.py's ADAPTERS keys. A test reads them with ast from the agent-kit commit in agentfiles.lock, and a CI step after lock --frozen runs it with a missing cache treated as a failure.
README and docs/PROFILES.md show a cli: example; ROADMAP R13 is marked done.

claims.claim: sync and plan exit 2 on a malformed cli: entry, name the role, tool and entry, and write no roles.yaml; a good entry is written verbatim and parses in second_opinion.py.
claims.check: bin/agentfiles plan/sync on a scratch repo under a temporary HOME and XDG dirs, then second_opinion.Spec.parse on the written entry
claims.remaining: Not run through a live cursor-agent review: that is the script's job and its own tests'.

claims.claim: Each bad shape fails (CLI: or leading-space prefix, cli:, cli:agent, cli::model, unknown agent, empty or blank model, each alone and as a list member) and good entries pass unchanged; with the check removed, 20 of these assertions fail.
claims.check: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests (108 tests, OK), and tests.test_roles with the check_cli_role call removed
claims.remaining: A string that only looks like cli: (clii:x, client:x) passes as a model name, as before.

claims.claim: CLI_AGENTS equals ADAPTERS in the locked agent-kit (1a6aa9c), and the test fails when they differ or when the source is not cached under AGENTFILES_REQUIRE_AGENT_KIT.
claims.check: tests.test_roles.CliAgentsMatchAgentKitTest run as is, with codex added to CLI_AGENTS, and with an empty XDG_CACHE_HOME
claims.remaining: The new CI step is proven only once this PR's CI runs.

release.note: agentfiles sync and plan now reject a malformed cli:<agent>:<model> role entry, naming the role, tool and entry, so a bad cross-model reviewer never reaches roles.yaml.
